Body.Content: End of life announced (EOLA) for Azure HDInsight for Apache Spark 2.4 was announced February 15, 2023 . Azure HDInsight for Apache Spark 2.4 will be retired as of February 10, 2024. We recommend that you upgrade your Apache Spark 2.4 workloads to version 3.1 or 3.3 at your earliest convenience.
